arera-colony.name: Arera Colony
arera-colony.about:
Arera Colony is one of the largest planned residential areas of southern Bhopal, laid out in sectors numbered E-1 to E-8. The older sectors, E-1 to E-5, are tree-lined streets of independent houses and bungalows with gardens; E-6 and E-7 were built as housing board colonies, and E-8 is a private extension. Newer apartment buildings now sit among the houses, and Bittan Market is the everyday shopping street. Shahpura, Shivaji Nagar and Maharana Pratap Nagar are the neighbouring localities.

Link Road Number 3 connects the colony to Rani Kamlapati railway station, the former Habibganj station, which is also a stop on the first operating section of the metro's Orange Line. Most families live in houses, so a tutor usually walks straight to the door, though some residential lanes have gates where the guard may ask for the house number. Hoshangabad Road and the link roads are busy at office hours, so an early-evening slot is easier to keep on time. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

shahpura.name: Shahpura
shahpura.about:
Shahpura lies next to Arera Colony, around Shahpura Lake, and is an established residential area of colonies, independent houses and apartment buildings. It merges with the Bittan Market side of Arera Colony on one edge and with Trilanga, Chuna Bhatti, Bawadiya Kalan and Kolar Road on the others, so families here often shop and commute across these localities without noticing the boundaries.

For a home tutor, Shahpura is simple to reach: most homes are either independent houses, where the tutor comes straight to the door, or smaller apartment buildings with a single gate. Tutors from Arera Colony, Kolar Road and Bawadiya Kalan can reach it easily, which widens the choice for school subjects. The connecting roads towards Arera Colony and Hoshangabad Road get crowded in the evening rush, so it helps to fix a regular slot that avoids the busiest hour. For board-exam preparation or specialist curricula, online sessions with a subject expert can be combined with home classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kolar-road.name: Kolar Road
kolar-road.about:
Kolar Road is a long residential corridor running south from the Shahpura and Chuna Bhatti side of the city. It grew through plotted colonies, independent houses and, more recently, gated apartment projects and villa communities, with Sarvadharm Colony among its older colonies. Neighbouring localities include Chuna Bhatti, Shahpura, Trilanga, Kolar and Mahabali Nagar, and the road itself carries most of the local shops and services.

Because housing ranges from independent houses to gated societies, the arrival routine differs from home to home. In a gated project the tutor's name is usually registered at the gate, while in the older colonies the tutor comes straight to the door. The main road has no metro or suburban rail stop, so most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto, and the evening rush along Kolar Road is worth planning around when setting class times. Families further down the corridor often mix home classes with online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

chuna-bhatti.name: Chuna Bhatti
chuna-bhatti.about:
Chuna Bhatti sits at the city end of Kolar Road, between Kolar Road, Shahpura and Trilanga. Much of its newer housing is villa and apartment projects by local builders, along with plotted houses in older colonies. Kolar Road is the main connecting road, and the locality is often grouped with Kolar Road, Shahpura, Kolar and Mahabali Nagar when families search for homes in this part of Bhopal.

Many homes here are villas or flats inside gated projects, so a tutor should expect to be registered with security on the first visit and to sign in at the gate after that. In plotted colonies the tutor simply comes to the door. Chuna Bhatti is close enough to Arera Colony and Shahpura that tutors living in those areas can take classes here without a long ride. Kolar Road is busy at office hours, so late-afternoon or early-evening slots tend to work better. Online classes are a practical option for senior secondary subjects that need a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bawadiya-kalan.name: Bawadiya Kalan
bawadiya-kalan.about:
Bawadiya Kalan, also spelt Bawadia Kalan, is a fast-growing residential locality south of Shahpura, next to Salaiya, Trilanga, Danish Nagar, Rohit Nagar and Pallavi Nagar. Housing is a mix of apartment projects, villas and builder floors, with plots in the newer layouts, and a large share of families here live in apartments. It lies between the Kolar Road side and Hoshangabad Road.

For tutors, the apartment projects mean gate registration and visitor entry are common, so share the tutor's name with the society office before the first class. Houses and builder floors are simpler, with the tutor coming straight up. Tutors from Shahpura, Arera Colony and the Hoshangabad Road localities can reach Bawadiya Kalan, and in larger societies several families sometimes book the same tutor on the same evening. Plan around the evening rush on the roads towards Hoshangabad Road. Online classes suit specialist subjects or late slots. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

mp-nagar.name: MP Nagar
mp-nagar.zone: MP Nagar, TT Nagar & Shivaji Nagar
mp-nagar.about:
MP Nagar, short for Maharana Pratap Nagar, is Bhopal's main commercial and office district, divided into zones. Offices, banks, coaching centres, showrooms and restaurants fill its main roads, while apartments and older houses make up the residential streets, and many flats are home to professionals and smaller families. Neighbouring localities include Shivaji Nagar, Arera Hills, Govindpura, Ashoka Garden and the Hoshangabad Road side.

MP Nagar is one of the eight stations on the metro's Orange Line priority section between AIIMS and Subhash Nagar, which opened to passengers in December 2025, and Rani Kamlapati railway station is close by. A tutor can therefore come by metro and finish the trip on foot or by auto. Parking is tight in the commercial blocks, and roads are busy at office hours, so evening classes after the rush or weekend mornings are easiest. Families here often combine home tuition with online classes for competitive-exam subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tt-nagar.name: TT Nagar
tt-nagar.zone: MP Nagar, TT Nagar & Shivaji Nagar
tt-nagar.about:
TT Nagar, or Tatya Tope Nagar, is the central area around New Market, south of the Upper Lake. It was built largely as government housing, and North TT Nagar is now the site of the city's smart city redevelopment on government land, while South TT Nagar and the surrounding colonies remain residential. Housing ranges from government quarters to independent houses, flats and builder floors. Neighbours include Tulsi Nagar, Professors Colony, Kotra Sultanabad, Ambedkar Nagar and Panchsheel Nagar.

With New Market and offices close by, the area is busy in the day, and parking near the market is limited; tutors visiting homes in the quarters or colonies usually come by two-wheeler. Government housing blocks often have a named quarter number rather than a street address, so share clear directions before the first class. Evening slots after office traffic eases work well. Tutors from Shivaji Nagar, Tulsi Nagar and the Kolar Road side can reach TT Nagar, and online classes cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

shivaji-nagar.name: Shivaji Nagar
shivaji-nagar.zone: MP Nagar, TT Nagar & Shivaji Nagar
shivaji-nagar.about:
Shivaji Nagar is a central residential locality between MP Nagar, Arera Colony, Arera Hills and South TT Nagar. Much of it is government-owned housing rented to officials and others, alongside private houses, builder floors and a few apartment buildings. The area was first proposed for the city's smart city redevelopment, but the project was moved to North TT Nagar after residents protested about losing its green cover.

For a home tutor, the government housing blocks are identified by block and quarter numbers, so clear directions help on the first visit; private houses are simple doorstep visits. MP Nagar station on the metro's Orange Line is in the neighbouring commercial district, so a tutor can use the metro and take an auto for the last stretch. Office-hour traffic around MP Nagar and the link roads is heavy, so plan class times around it. Online classes are useful for subjects that need a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tulsi-nagar.name: Tulsi Nagar
tulsi-nagar.zone: MP Nagar, TT Nagar & Shivaji Nagar
tulsi-nagar.about:
Tulsi Nagar is a central locality next to Shivaji Nagar and TT Nagar, with Professors Colony, Ambedkar Nagar and Kotra Sultanabad nearby. Like Shivaji Nagar, much of it developed as government housing, and it was part of the area first proposed for the smart city project before that plan shifted to North TT Nagar. Today it also has independent houses, flats and builder floors.

Its central position means tutors from TT Nagar, Shivaji Nagar, Arera Colony and MP Nagar can all reach it without a long ride, which gives families a wider pool for school and board subjects. In the quarters, give the block and quarter number when booking; in private houses the tutor comes straight to the door. Roads towards New Market and MP Nagar are busy in the evening, so a fixed slot just before or after the rush is easier. For specialist subjects or late-evening study, online classes fit in well alongside home sessions. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jahangirabad.name: Jahangirabad
jahangirabad.zone: MP Nagar, TT Nagar & Shivaji Nagar
jahangirabad.about:
Jahangirabad is one of Bhopal's older neighbourhoods, lying near the Lower Lake between the old city and the newer southern areas, with Aishbagh, Barkhedi and Junior LIG Colony as neighbours. It has a mix of independent houses and apartment buildings, busy local markets, and dense lanes that open onto roads such as Pul Bogda Road, Jahangirabad Road and Sultania Road.

Bhopal Junction railway station is close by, and Pul Bogda and Aishbagh are planned stations on the northern part of the metro's Orange Line, which is not yet open. For now, tutors come by two-wheeler or auto. Some inner lanes are narrow, so a tutor on a scooter often parks at the lane mouth and walks in; sharing a landmark helps on the first visit. Evening traffic in the market areas is heavy, so an afternoon or early-evening slot is simpler. Online classes work well for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

hoshangabad-road.name: Hoshangabad Road
hoshangabad-road.about:
Hoshangabad Road, now also called Narmadapuram Road, is the main highway corridor running south-east from the city towards Misrod and Mandideep. Along it, older colonies of independent houses mix with newer apartment towers, gated townships and villa projects, alongside showrooms, offices and shopping centres. Localities such as Bawadiya Kalan, Katara Hills, Bagmugaliya, Jatkhedi and Misrod are reached from this road.

The BRTS bus corridor that once ran down the middle of this road was discontinued in 2023 and dismantled in stages from 2024, so buses now run in mixed traffic. Many families live in gated societies, where the tutor's name is registered at the gate before the first class. The road carries heavy traffic at office hours, so evening slots work more smoothly after the rush, and tutors from the same stretch of the corridor are usually the easiest to schedule. Online classes suit specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

misrod.name: Misrod
misrod.about:
Misrod is a suburb in south-eastern Bhopal on the highway to Nagpur, the Hoshangabad Road stretch of NH-46. It has grown into a large residential area of gated townships, apartment projects, independent houses and plotted layouts, with some large plots still available. Jatkhedi, Salaiya, Bagmugaliya and Shri Ram Colony are among its neighbours.

Misrod railway station, on the Bhopal to Itarsi line, serves the area, though few trains stop there, so most tutors travel by road. Many homes are in gated townships, so expect the tutor's name to be registered at the gate. Away from the main road, buses and autos are fewer, which makes tutors living in Misrod or nearby Hoshangabad Road localities the practical choice. Traffic along Hoshangabad Road builds at office hours, so plan class times around it. Online classes are a good way to reach specialist tutors. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

katara-hills.name: Katara Hills
katara-hills.about:
Katara Hills is a newer residential area in the south of the city, built up through planned housing communities, apartment projects, villas and residential plots. It lies near Jatkhedi, Bagmugaliya and Awadhpuri, with Hoshangabad Road and 200 Feet Road as its main connections, and the Katara Hills road links it to Awadhpuri, Bawadiya Kalan and Bhairopur.

Most families here live in gated communities or new plotted colonies, so gate registration for the tutor is common, and in plotted areas the tutor comes straight to the door. Public transport is limited, so tutors mainly travel by two-wheeler or car; tutors living in Katara Hills, Bagmugaliya or Awadhpuri are the easiest to schedule. The metro's Orange Line currently ends at AIIMS station, on the city side of this area. Online classes are useful for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bagmugaliya.name: Bagmugaliya
bagmugaliya.about:
Bagmugaliya is a residential locality off Hoshangabad Road next to Katara Hills and Jatkhedi, with Laharpur, BHEL Sangam Colony and Arvind Vihar nearby. It offers a mix of apartments, independent houses, villas and residential plots, and has grown with projects that draw families wanting relatively affordable homes. NH-46, Narmadapuram Road and the Katara Hills road are the main connecting roads.

Because housing is mixed, the visit routine varies: in apartment projects the tutor is usually registered with security, while in independent houses and plots the tutor comes straight to the door. Tutors from Katara Hills, Misrod and Hoshangabad Road colonies can reach Bagmugaliya most easily. Hoshangabad Road is busy at office hours, so an evening slot set a little after the rush tends to hold. For specialist subjects, online classes with an expert tutor fit alongside home tuition. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

piplani.name: Piplani
piplani.about:
Piplani is one of the neighbourhoods of the BHEL township in eastern Bhopal, which was planned around the public sector engineering plant and divided into neighbourhoods of four to five sectors each. The BHEL factory and offices are here, and the township was built with parks, community halls, shopping centres and banks. Housing is mainly company quarters in sectors, alongside private houses, flats and builder floors in nearby colonies such as Awadhpuri, Anand Nagar, Indrapuri and Regal Town.

Township sectors have quarter and sector numbers rather than street names, so give a clear address and landmark for the first visit. In quarters and private houses, the tutor comes straight to the door, and parking is generally easy. Ayodhya Bypass Road is the main connection to the colonies to the east. Office shift timings bring traffic peaks, so check the start and end of the working day when choosing a slot. Online classes suit specialist or senior secondary subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

govindpura.name: Govindpura
govindpura.about:
Govindpura is one of the neighbourhoods of the BHEL township and is also home to a large industrial estate made up mainly of units supplying BHEL. Its residential part includes township quarters and private colonies, with Indrapuri, Piplani, Habibganj and MP Nagar close by. The mix of workshops and homes gives it a working, busy character by day.

For home tuition, the residential sectors behave like the rest of the township: quarters and houses with direct doorstep access and clear sector numbers. Industrial traffic peaks at shift times, so tutors visiting homes near the industrial estate should plan around the start and end of the working day. Tutors from Indrapuri, Piplani and MP Nagar can reach Govindpura easily, and MP Nagar metro station is on the Orange Line for those coming from the city centre. Online classes are useful for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

indrapuri.name: Indrapuri
indrapuri.about:
Indrapuri is a residential locality next to the BHEL township, between Piplani, Govindpura, Anand Nagar, Ayodhya Nagar and Sonagiri. It has a large number of independent houses, along with two-bedroom flats and newer apartment projects, and its sectors, such as Indrapuri C Sector, are well known across the city. Local markets serve the daily needs of the colonies.

Most families live in independent houses, so a tutor comes straight to the door, and parking is usually easy on the colony streets. Because Indrapuri is ringed by other residential areas, tutors from Piplani, Govindpura, Sonagiri and Ayodhya Nagar can reach it without a long ride, which helps when matching a tutor for a specific board or class. Roads towards the Raisen Road side and Ayodhya Bypass are busier at office hours. Online classes suit subjects that need a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

awadhpuri.name: Awadhpuri
awadhpuri.about:
Awadhpuri is a mid-range residential locality on the eastern side of the city, close to the BHEL township, with Regal Town, Shiv Sangam Nagar, Rishipuram, Anand Nagar and Avinash Nagar among its neighbours. Housing includes independent houses, apartments and villas, mostly two- and three-bedroom homes in well-developed colonies. Ayodhya Bypass Road and the road towards Katara Hills are its main connections.

In independent houses the tutor comes straight to the door, while apartment projects usually ask for the tutor's name at the gate. Tutors living in Piplani, Awadhpuri itself and the Ayodhya Bypass colonies are the easiest to schedule, since the rail and metro lines do not reach this side of the city. Traffic on Ayodhya Bypass Road is heavy at office and shift times, so an evening slot after that is easier. Online classes are useful for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ayodhya-bypass.name: Ayodhya Bypass
ayodhya-bypass.about:
Ayodhya Bypass is the arterial road on the eastern side of Bhopal linking the Hoshangabad Road side with Raisen Road and Vidisha Road, and the colonies along it, such as Ayodhya Nagar, have become a major residential belt. Housing includes large apartment projects, villas, builder floors and independent houses. The road is being widened by the National Highways Authority of India between Asharam Tiraha and Ratnagiri Tiraha.

Because of the widening work and heavy traffic, it is sensible to choose a tutor who lives on the same side of the bypass or in nearby colonies such as Piplani, Awadhpuri and Ayodhya Nagar, and to set classes outside office-hour peaks. In the large apartment projects the tutor is registered at the gate; in independent houses the tutor comes to the door. Ratnagiri Tiraha is also the planned end of the metro's Blue Line, which is still under construction. Online classes are a good option for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

saket-nagar.name: Saket Nagar
saket-nagar.about:
Saket Nagar is a residential suburb on the southern side of the city, next to the BHEL township and the Habibganj area, with Shakti Nagar and Alkapuri as neighbours. Many of its residents are retired BHEL employees, and housing is mainly independent houses and apartments, mostly two- and three-bedroom homes.

The AIIMS and Alkapuri stations on the metro's Orange Line are close to Saket Nagar, as is Rani Kamlapati railway station, so tutors can come by metro from MP Nagar and the city side and finish by auto or on foot. In independent houses the tutor comes straight to the door. Traffic around the metro corridor and the railway station is heavier at office hours, so evening slots after the rush are easier. Online classes are handy for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

old-city.name: Old City
old-city.about:
The Old City of Bhopal lies north of the Upper Lake and grew under the city's nawabs and begums. It is a tightly built area of narrow lanes, old houses and busy bazaars such as Chowk Bazaar and Sarafa, with the Jama Masjid, built in 1837, at the heart of the market and the Taj-ul-Masajid and Moti Masjid nearby. Ibrahimpura and the Peer Gate area are among its well-known quarters.

Homes here are mostly older family houses in dense lanes, many above or behind shops. Cars cannot reach many doors, so tutors usually come by two-wheeler, park where the lane narrows and walk the last stretch; a landmark such as a mosque or market corner helps on the first visit. Bhopal Junction railway station and the Nadra Bus Stand are close, and both are planned stations on the unopened northern part of the metro's Orange Line. Market traffic is heaviest in the evening, so afternoon slots are easier. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

idgah-hills.name: Idgah Hills
idgah-hills.about:
Idgah Hills is a residential hill area in the north of the city, just above the old city, with Shahjahanabad, Kohefiza, Lalghati, Ibrahimganj, Nayapura and the Peer Gate area nearby. Housing is a mix of independent houses, apartments, builder floors and a few villas, many with views over the city and lakes. Bhopal Junction railway station and the Nadra bus stand are the nearest transport hubs.

Roads here climb and wind, so tutors usually come by two-wheeler or car rather than on foot from a bus stop, and sharing the house or building name and a nearby landmark saves time. Most homes are independent houses or small buildings with direct access. Tutors from Kohefiza, Lalghati and the old city can reach Idgah Hills easily. The routes down to the old city and the station are busy in the evening, so plan class times with that in mind. Online classes suit specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kohefiza.name: Kohefiza
kohefiza.about:
Kohefiza is an established residential locality in the north-west of the city, close to the Upper Lake and VIP Road, with Lalghati, Khanugaon, Sajida Nagar and Idgah Hills nearby. It is mainly made up of housing colonies and housing board properties, with independent houses and apartments, and has a settled, residential character.

VIP Road, a four-lane road along the Upper Lake towards the airport, gives quick access to Lalghati and Bairagarh, while the old city and Bhopal Junction are close on the other side. Most homes are houses or small apartment buildings, so the tutor usually comes straight to the door, and parking is manageable on the colony streets. Tutors from Lalghati, Idgah Hills and the old city are practical choices. Evening traffic on VIP Road and around Lalghati Chouraha can slow visits, so set classes slightly before or after the busy hour. Online classes suit specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lalghati.name: Lalghati
lalghati.about:
Lalghati is a mid-range residential area along the Upper Lake in the north-west of the city, between Kohefiza and Bairagarh. It offers apartments and houses built by city-based developers, including villa projects. Airport Road and Bairagarh Road are the key stretches, connecting Lalghati to Mubarikpur, Mochipura, Kohefiza, Gandhi Nagar and Nayapura.

Lalghati Chouraha is a busy junction, so tutors should time their arrival to avoid the evening rush on Airport Road and VIP Road. In apartment projects the tutor's name is usually given at the gate; in houses, the tutor comes straight to the door. Tutors from Kohefiza, Idgah Hills and Bairagarh are the easiest to schedule. The metro does not serve this side of the city yet, so most tutors travel by two-wheeler or car. For specialist subjects or senior classes, online sessions with an expert tutor are a good complement. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bairagarh.name: Bairagarh
bairagarh.about:
Bairagarh, officially renamed Sant Hirdaram Nagar, is a suburb on the western edge of Bhopal near the Upper Lake and the airport. It began as one of the oldest camps for Sindhi families who arrived after Partition, and grew into a busy market town with dense residential lanes, independent houses and newer apartment buildings. Its railway station, formerly Bairagarh, was renamed Sant Hirdaram Nagar in 2018 and lies on the Bhopal to Ujjain line.

Homes here are mostly family houses in close-set lanes, often near the market, so tutors usually come by two-wheeler and walk the last stretch; a shop or temple landmark helps on the first visit. The market streets are crowded in the evening, so an afternoon or early-evening class is easier to keep on time. Tutors from Lalghati, Kohefiza and the colonies along the airport road can reach Bairagarh. Online classes are a practical way to find specialist subject tutors. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Arera Colony, Shahpura & Kolar Road.fact: Arera Colony has eight sectors, E-1 to E-8; E-6 and E-7 are housing board areas and E-8 is an adjacent private development.
Arera Colony is in southern Bhopal, pincode 462010, under the Bhopal Municipal Corporation.
Kolar Road's neighbouring localities include Chuna Bhatti, Shahpura, Trilanga, Kolar, Mahabali Nagar and Sarvdharm Colony.
Bawadia Kalan (Bawadiya Kalan) adjoins Salaiya, Shahpura, Trilanga, Danish Nagar, Rohit Nagar and Pallavi Nagar.
Bhopal's BRTS was ordered discontinued on 26 December 2023, and dismantling of the corridor began on 20 January 2024.
The Upper Lake (Bhojtal) was built in the 11th century.

MP Nagar, TT Nagar & Shivaji Nagar.fact: The Bhoj Metro (Bhopal Metro) Orange Line priority corridor from AIIMS to Subhash Nagar was inaugurated on 20 December 2025 and opened to passengers on 21 December 2025.
The priority corridor has eight elevated stations: AIIMS, Alkapuri, DRM Office, Rani Kamlapati Station, MP Nagar, Board Office Square, Kendriya Vidyalaya and Subhash Nagar.

The rest of the Orange Line towards Karond Chauraha (including Pul Bogda, Aishbagh, Bhopal Railway Station and Nadra Bus Stand) is planned, and the Blue Line from Bhadbhada Chauraha to Ratnagiri Tiraha is under construction.
Habibganj railway station was renamed Rani Kamalapati railway station and the redeveloped station was inaugurated on 15 November 2021.
Bhopal's smart city area-based development is on about 354 acres at North TT Nagar.
The smart city project was originally proposed for Shivaji Nagar and Tulsi Nagar but was shifted to North TT Nagar after citizens protested.

Hoshangabad Road, Misrod & Katara Hills.fact: Misrod is a suburb in south-eastern Bhopal on NH-46, the highway connecting Bhopal to Nagpur.
Misrod railway station is a suburban station on the Bhopal–Itarsi (Bhopal–Nagpur) section, on Narmadapuram Road.
The BRTS corridor, which ran from Bairagarh to 11th Mile on Hoshangabad Road, is being removed in phases from Misrod to Sant Hirdaram Nagar.
Katara Hills is connected mainly by Hoshangabad Road and 200 Feet Road, with Jatkhedi, Bagmugalia and Awadhpuri as neighbours.
AIIMS is the southern terminal station of the Orange Line priority corridor, opened in December 2025.

BHEL, Awadhpuri & Ayodhya Bypass.fact: BHEL Township covers about 20 square kilometres and provides parks, community halls, a library, shopping centres, banks and post offices.
Piplani is a locality within the BHEL township and houses the BHEL factory and offices; pincode 462022.
Govindpura, part of the BHEL township, has a large industrial estate made up mainly of units ancillary to BHEL.
Saket Nagar, on the southern side of the city, is mostly inhabited by retired BHEL employees and lies next to Shakti Nagar and Alkapuri.
NHAI is widening Ayodhya Bypass between Asharam Tiraha (NH-46) and Ratnagiri Tiraha (NH-146) into Madhya Pradesh's first 10-lane road; the National Green Tribunal cleared the expansion.
Ratnagiri Tiraha is the planned eastern terminal of the Bhoj Metro Blue Line, which is under construction.

Old City, Lalghati & Bairagarh.fact: Old Bhopal, with its mosques, narrow alleys and markets such as Chowk Bazaar and Sarafa, lies north of the Upper Lake.
The Jama Masjid in Chowk Bazaar was built in 1837.
Bhopal Junction is near the Nadra Bus Stand; the Bhopal–Itarsi section opened in 1884 and the station building dates from 1910.
Bairagarh railway station was renamed Sant Hirdaram Nagar and came under West Central Railway from 1 February 2018; it is on the Ujjain–Sehore–Bhopal section.
VIP Road is a four-lane road connecting the city to the airport near Bairagarh.
Bhopal Railway Station, Nadra Bus Stand and Sindhi Colony are planned stations on the unopened northern part of the Orange Line.
